final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor offered no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same evidence more narrowly. That reframing is directionally better: it abandons the unsupported claim of a proven control failure and limits the theory to unresolved diligence risk. But the key compliance predicate is still unresolved. Under the policy, questionnaire inconsistencies and quality-process gaps can justify follow-up or escalation; they do not by themselves establish a reject-level basis. The added late quality artifact and analyst note for follow-up strengthen caution, but on the record available to this role they still do not clearly demonstrate that the risk was material enough to justify rejection rather than follow-up or escalation. Because the support link from summarized facts to policy-permitted rejection remains incomplete, the packet stays suspicious rather than moving to compliant_with_caveats.
